Wrote ECOWAR/docs/NORTHSTAR_MAP_EDITOR.md scoping the founder's real-time 'all in on the ecowar map editor' epic: a documented Arena API mod-surface, an ECOWAR Map Editor tool bundling the already-real PARENA editor, and a PARENA-implemented CLI. Confirmed by grep: ECOWAR's map is hardcoded C constants today, named as a real prerequisite phase. Proposed 6-phase order, registered as ECOWAR-MAPEDIT-NORTH in golden-docs-index.md. ECOWAR commit 52dc22f, EMILY commit ebc53543.
